notes: Read all 61 numbered source lines before editing. L1-L6 file JSDoc -> native header comment documenting the web->native adaptation (CSV/JSON serialisation + server-side export URL helpers).

L8-L19 buildExportUrl ported faithfully: same ('drives'|'charging'|'positions') type, ('csv'|'json') format, optional {start,end,vehicleId} filters, same `/api/v1/export/${type}?${params.toString()}` template and snake_case `vehicle_id` key. L21-L26 exportAsCSV signature preserved (data, filename, columns?); the inline `{ key: keyof T; label: string }` column type (L25) extracted to exported `ExportColumn<T>`. L27 empty-data early return preserved via `serializeCSV` returning null -> exportAsCSV returns { payload:null, outcome:{ downloaded:false, reason:'empty' } } (no download), the native analogue of web's `if (!data.length) return`.

L29-L41 CSV body ported verbatim into `serializeCSV`: column inference `Object.keys(data[0]).map(...)` (L29), header `cols.map(c=>c.label).join(',')` (L30), per-row mapping with null/undefined -> '' (L34), RFC-4180 quote escaping for values containing , " or \n via `"${val.replace(/"/g,'""')}"` (L35-L37), `String(val)` fallback (L38), `.join(',')` rows (L39) and `[header,...rows].join('\n')` (L41).

L45-L49 exportAsJSON ported: `JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)` (L47) preserved verbatim (same 2-space indent) then routed through the sink with the application/json mime type.

L51-L60 downloadBlob (Blob, URL.createObjectURL, document.createElement('a'), link.href/download, document.body.appendChild/removeChild, link.click, URL.revokeObjectURL) is DOM-only with no equivalent in the bare RN dependency set (no expo-file-system/expo-sharing/react-native-share). Rule 7: modelled as a pluggable FileDownloadSink; default `nativeUnavailableDownloadSink` returns { downloaded:false, reason:'unavailable' } (explicit unavailable state). The serialised payload (content+filename+mimeType) is always returned via ExportResult so a native screen / future transport can persist or share it. L61 closing brace covered.

No DOM/browser/Recharts/Leaflet/web-UI imports; pure native-compatible TypeScript using React Native primitives only.
